capabilities: Chat with vault context in a sidebar using your own LLM keys
Read, search, create, and edit notes through tools and sub-agents
Review, accept, or discard AI file edits with checkpoints
Define custom right-click AI actions and custom sub-agents
Transcribe audio, generate images, and search the web as optional tools
extras: Several features are flagged experimental (custom agents, embeddings, JavaScript Code Executor), and the README warns the code executor runs through the plugin, not a hardened sandbox. Works on desktop and mobile with UI translations in five languages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so using AI with vault context means switching to outside tools or manually pasting notes back and forth.
